from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,os,struct,subprocess
R=Path.cwd();O=R/'.tools/review7-request-bootstrap-originals';O.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
profile=json.loads((R/'tests/semantics/profile.json').read_text());flags=[arg for k,v in profile.items() for arg in ['-d',k+'='+v]]
cases=[('proxy-duplicate',[b'HTTP_PROXY=first',b'HTTP_PROXY=last',b'DUP=first',b'DUP=last'],[],b'<?php echo $_ENV["HTTP_PROXY"],":",$_SERVER["HTTP_PROXY"],":",$_ENV["DUP"],":",$_SERVER["DUP"];'),('proxy-empty-first',[b'HTTP_PROXY=',b'HTTP_PROXY=last'],[],b'<?php echo "[",$_ENV["HTTP_PROXY"],"][",$_SERVER["HTTP_PROXY"],"]";'),('proxy-case-sensitive',[b'http_proxy=lower',b'HTTP_PROXY=upper',b'http_proxy=last'],[],b'<?php echo $_ENV["HTTP_PROXY"],":",$_ENV["http_proxy"];'),('server-overwrite-order',[b'REQUEST_TIME=old',b'argv=old',b'PHP_SELF=old',b'REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT=old',b'argc=old',b'SCRIPT_FILENAME=old',b'Z=last'],[],b'<?php foreach($_SERVER as $k=>$v){echo "[",$k,"]";} echo ":",$_SERVER["REQUEST_TIME"],":",$_SERVER["REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT"],":",$_SERVER["argc"],":",$_SERVER["argv"][1];'),('argc-disabled',[],['register_argc_argv=0'],b'<?php echo $argc,":",$argv[1],":",$_SERVER["argc"],":",$_SERVER["argv"][1];'),('server-disabled',[],['variables_order=EGPC'],b'<?php echo $argc,":",$argv[1],":";foreach($_SERVER as $k=>$v){echo $k;}'),('env-disabled',[b'A=one'],['variables_order=GPCS'],b'<?php echo empty($_ENV),":",$_SERVER["A"];'),('jit-disabled',[b'A=one'],['auto_globals_jit=0'],b'<?php foreach($GLOBALS as $k=>$v){echo "[",$k,"]";}')]
records=[]
for name,env,ini,source in cases:
 p=O/(name+'.php');p.write_bytes(source);entries=[b'LC_ALL=C',b'TZ=UTC',*env];payload=b'PHPRQ001'+struct.pack('<qII',-1,500000,len(entries))+b''.join(struct.pack('<I',len(e))+e for e in entries);q=O/(name+'.input');q.write_bytes(payload);cmd=[str(R/'.tools/php/bin/php'),'-n',*flags,'-d','variables_order=EGPCS',*[arg for v in ini for arg in ['-d',v]],str(p),'alpha','beta']
 with q.open('rb') as f:
  os.dup2(f.fileno(),198)
  try:run=subprocess.run(cmd,env={'LD_PRELOAD':str(R/'.tools/request-clock.so')},pass_fds=(198,),cwd=O,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
  finally:os.close(198)
 row={'id':name,'source_base64':base64.b64encode(source).decode(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'context':str(p),'environment_base64':[base64.b64encode(e).decode() for e in entries],'clock':[-1,500000],'extra_ini':ini,'command':cmd,'cwd':str(O),'payload_base64':base64.b64encode(payload).decode(),'oracle':{'stdout':base64.b64encode(run.stdout).decode(),'stderr':base64.b64encode(run.stderr).decode(),'exit_status':run.returncode}};records.append(row);print(name,run.returncode,run.stdout,run.stderr,flush=True)
r={'scope':'Independent explicit primitive-input native originals before request bootstrap implementation; provider instrumented pinned CLI, no semantic agreements claimed. Authored environment only.','inputs':{p:hashlib.sha256((R/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ['.tools/php/bin/php','.tools/request-clock.so','native/request_clock.c','tests/semantics/profile.json','vendor/php-src/main/php_variables.c','vendor/php-src/sapi/cli/php_cli.c']},'records':records};(O/'originals.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
